display_name: LoRa W24 独立整包网络长训及复数损失对照（Full）
description: Both packet-attention arms train from the same scratch parameters for 12000 updates. Match input pairs, optimizer and budget; compare original risks against band-balanced complex reconstruction, adjacent-chirp contrast, and clean center/guard identity.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal, lawful source U_s same-waveform paired IQ, frozen W24 only after added source coefficients freeze, Full route.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Native source split 392005. 8192 available U_s fit and 160 disjoint heldout. 300 frozen source V IDs, with direct and outer decisions from original immutable source matrix.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source calibration and source screen. No F/TX/V/target access at fit or freeze. DURA and W24 checkpoints read only for their allowed roles.

checkpoint.initialization: From scratch, equal initialized random parameters, 404695 learned per arm. No DURA weight reused. Fixed public analytic aperture and tracking code.

sources.role: Frozen source predictions used as a matched comparison after both scratch candidates freeze
Pinned analytic aperture, tracking and generic waveform generator code only, no learned checkpoint

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No historical restoration weight used in fit, freeze or candidate predictions. Historical outer predictions appended by unchanged physical order for post-freeze paired scoring only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Prelocked checkpoints 1200,6000,12000; no best-of selection. At final step only, promotion requires balanced_full at least parent+18 six, parent+10 low, clean at least direct, and positive six and low over matched original_loss_final_full.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 one GPU, 3 then 6,0, >=12 GiB available and existing per-card process cap.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source contract or frozen lineage mismatch, failed no-query smoke, nonfinite risk or heldout, missing fixed checkpoint/prediction, or independent scoring failure.

metric_names: practical accuracy by step and arm

rows.method: Matched scratch full-packet attention, original loss versus balanced 4 bands, pairwise adjacent chirp residual, and explicit measured clean center and guard identity.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: 12000 updates per arm, batch 8, identical source pool and generic draw stream, same AdamW LR and gradient clip. Evaluate fixed 1200,6000,12000 at final freeze; each arm both center and full.

notes: 12000 is ten times the initial screening steps, with 96000 source presentations per arm.
Long schedules use one packet-attention architecture and identical seeded inputs. Objective alone differs between arms.
The three fixed wave-only holdout benchmarks share independent physical source IDs and seeded perturbations.
